The available records associate Abrus precatorius Linn. with the following media:

1. Distilled Water [1, 12]
2. Cow Milk [2, 4, 6, 11, 14, 15]
3. Sour Gruel [3, 8, 10, 13, 16]
4. Lemon Juice [5, 7]
5. Water [9]

6. Sesame Oil [16, 21, 24, 28, 34, 39, 44, 50, 57, 61, 67]
7. Oxalis Corniculata Juice [31, 64]
8. Lemon Juice [47]
9. Suveeraka [54]
10. Nirgundi Decoction [70]

Confirmation Studys associated with Biotite Mica

The available records associate Biotite Mica with the following confirmation studys:

1. Brine Shrimp Lethality Assay [1]
2. X-Ray Diffraction (XRD) [2, 6, 9]
3. Atomic Absorption Spectrometry (AAS) [3, 11]
4. Antimicrobial Activity Test [4]
5. Cation Exchange Capacity (CEC) Analysis [5]
6. Inductively Coupled Plasma-Atomic Emission Spectroscopy (ICP-AES) [7, 10]
7. Particle Size Distribution (PSD) [8]
8. Energy Dispersive X-Ray Spectroscopy (EDAX) [12]
9. Field Emission Scanning Electron Microscopy (FESEM) [13]

expanded_provenance_compound_method_medi.answer:
Media associated with Copper

The available records associate Copper with the following media:

1. Cow Urine [1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 14, 19, 26, 32, 37, 42, 48, 55, 59, 65]
2. Sour Gruel [5, 11, 15, 20, 27, 33, 38, 43, 49, 56, 60, 66]
3. Rock Salt [10, 53]
4. Buttermilk [12, 17, 22, 25, 29, 35, 40, 45, 51, 62, 68]
5. Horse Gram Decoction [13, 18, 23, 30, 36, 41, 46, 52, 58, 63, 69]
6. Sesame Oil [16, 21, 24, 28, 34, 39, 44, 50, 57, 61, 67]
7. Oxalis Corniculata Juice [31, 64]
8. Lemon Juice [47]
9. Suveeraka [54]
10. Nirgundi Decoction [70]
